title: Requiem & Decryption
subtitle: Clues, card order and Lich hunts

entries.title: How a Hunt Works
entries.summary: One full round, from clues to rewards

blocks.text: This chapter's target is the boss, the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}. Knocking it down is not a win, Tenno. First work out an <hl>answer</hl> that belongs to you alone, then kill it with that answer in place; only then does the hunt succeed.

items: Gather clues: kill Kuva enemies such as the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave} yourself to build decryption progress. Each full stage reveals one card of the answer. [[requiem/decryption|More]]

Get the cards: there are 8 kinds of Requiem Cards, and your answer is 3 of them, so you need those three in hand. Mining {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore} drops them, and you can trade 3 cards you don't need for 1 random new one. [[requiem/requiem_cards|More]]
Set the cards: place the three cards in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate} in the order you guess. [[requiem/requiem_gate|More]]
Hunt: kill a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} with your own hand. The answer is checked the moment it falls.

Result: a right guess is a decryption success, and once you collect the rewards a new round begins. A wrong guess means Lich level +1; adjust your cards and try again. [[requiem/decrypt_failure|More]]

blocks.text: Look up unfamiliar terms in [[start/glossary]].

In the Origin System, a Kuva Lich takes over planets on the Star Chart. Run missions in its territory and it skims a share of everything you earn; you only get it back once the Lich is defeated. Skimming from the Operator... Ordis would like to wring the Kuva out of it, drop by drop, until... Pardon. Interference on the comm line.

entries.title: Decryption Progress
entries.summary: Kill Kuva enemies to reveal three clues

blocks.text: Your <hl>answer</hl> belongs to you alone: 3 [[requiem/requiem_cards|Requiem Cards]] in a fixed order. It starts out hidden, and you uncover it one card at a time by killing Kuva enemies for <t>decryption progress</t>.
The {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave} never appears in the wild, so you build progress by killing the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} instead.

blocks.title: Land the killing blow yourself
blocks.text: Progress goes only to whoever lands the killing blow with their own hand; in a group, that is the finisher. Kills by pets, lava, or bonus element damage such as burning or electricity don't count. Finish enemies off yourself, with melee or arrows.
Three stages

items: Each full stage reveals one answer card and the bar starts over; <g>leftover points carry into the next stage</g>.
<hl>The moment Clue 1 appears, the whole answer is locked in</hl>, and which 3 cards go in which order never changes after that. From then on you can challenge at any time.
Revealed cards show up in the clue slots on the bottom row of the [[requiem/requiem_gate]] screen. <w>Clue slot positions are random and do not show the order.</w>
After all three clues are revealed, kills stop adding progress and the action bar reminds you to set your cards.

blocks.text: The archives call this progress Murmurs, a rather graceful name. Each full stage reveals one Requiem mod, and once all three are full, the whole answer lies open.

Whenever you gain progress, a bar pops up at the top of the screen showing <t>Clue N/3</t> and your current points, and fades after about <t>4</t> seconds. The action bar also reports how many points you just gained.

blocks.title: Progress stays with you
blocks.text: Progress, clues and the answer are stored on you, so dying, logging out or changing dimensions loses nothing, and everyone keeps their own. Only a <g>successful decryption</g> clears them, and the next round rolls a new answer.
From Clue 1 onward, anything you pick up may be confiscated by the Lich; see [[requiem/confiscation]].
Advanced details

items: For a Lich, both ends of the Thrall range are multiplied and rounded down, and the progress is a random value between them.
The kill that completes a successful decryption adds no progress; the round's progress is cleared at once.
One kill reveals at most one card, even if the points would cover two stages.

A killing blow from bonus [[combat/elements|element]] damage, such as burning or gas damage over time or the extra hit from electricity or blast, does not count at all. You get no progress, and the enemy drops none of its loot. The same goes for kills by pets or lava.

blocks.text: Requiem Cards are the keys you slot into the [[requiem/requiem_gate]]. There are 8 kinds, and your answer is <t>3 different cards</t> among them, in a fixed order.

items: kuvalich:khra
kuvalich:jahu
kuvalich:fass
kuvalich:lohk
kuvalich:netra
kuvalich:vome
kuvalich:xata
kuvalich:ris
blocks.caption: All 8 Requiem Cards

blocks.text: The 3 cards are all different, which allows 8 × 7 × 6 = <t>336</t> sequences, so two copies of the same card can never be right.
Only a success costs durability

items: Each <g>successful decryption</g> takes 1 use from each of the three cards in the Gate. One set lasts at most <t>3</t> successes.
<g>A failed decryption costs no durability</g>. Inserting, removing or reordering cards costs nothing either, so testing orders is free.
After a success, cards with uses left go back to your inventory; if it is full, they drop where the [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] died.
Requiem Cards don't stack; one per slot.

blocks.text: Each of these 8 names comes from the Requiem mods of the Origin System. There, too, every one has a limited number of uses and is gone once they run out.
Where to get them

rows: Each block may drop 1 random card; chances below, details in [[world/requiem_ore]]
Any 3 cards become 1 random <g>new card</g>, see [[weapons/requiem_recast]]
<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.baseCardDropChance|pctv}</t>; <w>each Fortune level lowers it by {cfg:kuva_lich.fortuneReductionPerLevel|pctv}</w>, down to <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.minCardDropChance|pctv}</t>

blocks.title: Recycle worn cards
blocks.text: Put three yellow cards with 1 use left into the {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast} to get back 1 fresh card with 3 uses. The new card is equally likely to be any of the 8 and may repeat one you put in.

entries.title: Requiem Gate
entries.summary: Setting cards, the challenge and rewards
items: kuvalich:requiem_gate

blocks.text: The {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate} is the block that holds your answer. Put three [[requiem/requiem_cards|Requiem Cards]] in it in the order you guess, then kill a [[enemies/kuva_master]]; the answer is checked the moment it dies.
The screen

rows: Your answer, positions 1, 2, 3 from left to right
Decryption progress for the current stage
Revealed clue cards; <w>positions are random, not the order</w>

blocks.title: Cards live on you, not in the block
blocks.text: Closing the screen saves the cards to your own data, so every Requiem Gate shows you your own cards and shows others theirs. Breaking the block drops no cards.
The challenge

items: Reveal at least 1 clue first, see [[requiem/decryption]]. Challenging with no clue revealed always fails.
Right-click the Requiem Gate, fill all three slots with cards and close the screen to save.

items.text: Find a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} in the wild or summon one with a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}, then land the killing blow yourself.
Find a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} in the wild and land the killing blow yourself.
Summon a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} with a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum} and land the killing blow yourself.

items: Check the result. A success drops rewards; on a failure, chat tells you how many positions in a row you got right, counting from the first (see [[requiem/decrypt_failure]]).

header: In the Gate at the kill
rows: Not a challenge, so you only get progress and no penalty
<g>Decryption success</g>: you get the rewards below, and the round resets
Decryption failure: [[requiem/decrypt_failure|Lich level]] +1, no durability lost, and you still get progress

blocks.text: Success rewards

items: Kuva weapons come only from successful Lich hunts, with a level rolled within your weapon level range; see [[weapons/kuva_weapons]].

A new character's range is <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.baseMinimumLevel}~{cfg:kuva_lich.baseMaximumLevel}</t>, and your first success rolls a weapon level inside it. Each later success raises the range until it hits its cap; see [[weapons/weapon_level]].

Mods are upgrade cards you fit to a weapon or to yourself, and the high-tier mod here comes from the top two quality tiers, {cfg:kuva_lich.masterPrimeModuleChance|pctv} Prime and the rest Riven; see [[modules/module_rarity]].
<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleWeaponRatio|pctv}</t> of them are weapon mods and the rest are Warframe mods. Here the “Warframe” is you, so Warframe mods go on yourself.

blocks.title: Rewards drop where the Lich dies
blocks.text: <w>Don't finish it near lava, the void or deep water</w>. Apart from the cards that return to your inventory, every reward drops where the Lich dies.
Advanced details

items: Stay within <t>8</t> blocks of the Gate while its screen is open.
Once two or more clues are revealed, the bottom-row clue cards keep shuffling.
To get progress from a Lich kill without risking a failure, take one card out of the Gate first.
If your inventory is full, unspent Requiem Cards drop at the Lich's death spot.

After each success, the minimum and maximum of your weapon level range both rise by the same random amount, {cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevelCapIncrease}~{cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevelCapIncrease}, capped at {cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevel} and {cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevel} respectively.
Both ends rise by the same amount, so the range keeps its width until one end hits its cap. This kill's weapon uses the range from before the increase.
In Creative mode, press <t>TAB</t> in the Requiem Gate to fill in the correct answer. It only works once at least 1 clue is revealed, and your old cards go back to your inventory.

entries.title: Failure & Guessing the Order
entries.summary: What a wrong guess costs, and max tries

blocks.text: Test orders methodically, because the cost of a wrong guess stays on you until a decryption succeeds. Killing a [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] with all three slots filled but wrong is a decryption failure. Chat gives you a hint to narrow things down, and the cost is Lich level +1.
Hints on failure

rows: Positions 1 and 2 are right; only position 3 is wrong
Position 1 is wrong; nothing about the other two

blocks.text: Hints only count from the left, and position 2 is checked only when position 1 is right.

blocks.title: When the first two are right
blocks.text: If your three cards are all different and the first two are right, the third card is not in the answer at all, so swap in a different one.
When you know all three cards

items: Put the three cards in any order and kill a Lich.
If position 1 is right, swap the last two, and the next try wins.
If there is no hint, move one of the other two cards into position 1 and try again.
Still no hint means position 1 is the remaining card. Put it in place; you can miss at most once more, and if you do, swap the last two.

blocks.text: This way you fail at most 3 times, and the 4th try always wins. With a {item:kuvalich:requiem_riddle} in hand, use it and you won't miss even once.
The cost of failing: Lich level
Each failure raises your Lich level by 1, and chat reports the new level. It is stored on you, survives death and logging out, and only resets on a successful decryption.
Damage Kuva enemies deal to you × (1 + Lich level × {cfg:kuva_lich.increaseDamage})
Damage you deal to Kuva enemies × (1 − Lich level × {cfg:kuva_lich.reducedDamage}), reduced by at most 99.9%

blocks.title: Only against Kuva enemies
blocks.text: Your Lich level only affects damage between you and Kuva enemies, which means Thralls and Liches. Damage involving falls, other mobs or other people is unaffected, so everyday exploring goes on as usual.
Your Lich level does not change the damage you deal or take; a wrong guess only adds 1 to the number.
A Lich of the Origin System, stabbed with the wrong Requiem mods, does not fall. It ranks up instead and grows stronger.

blocks.title: Long fights get dangerous
blocks.text: Once a Kuva enemy has a target, its damage grows by <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.battleBoost|pct}</t> of its base every second (see [[enemies/battle_boost]]). If the hunt turns against you, back off first; once it loses its target, the boost drains at the same rate.

entries.title: Confiscation & Return
entries.summary: The Lich takes pickups until you win

blocks.text: Whatever the Lich takes, you get all of it back only when the decryption succeeds, Tenno. From the moment you reveal Clue 1 until you win the round, anything you pick up may be confiscated by the [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]], the whole stack at once.

rows: When you touch a dropped item to pick it up
From Clue 1 until a successful decryption
Everything at once on a successful decryption

blocks.title: It takes the whole stack
blocks.text: It takes <w>the entire stack</w> you were picking up, so a dropped stack of 64 diamonds means all 64 are gone. The limit counts confiscations, one per stack, not individual items.

items: Items already in your inventory are never taken.
When something is confiscated, the Lich taunts you in chat.
Confiscated items are recorded on you; dying, logging out or changing dimensions does not lose them.
A failed decryption returns nothing and does not reset the limit; only a success counts.
Picking up your own drops after dying rolls for every stack as well.

blocks.title: With a full inventory, step off the drops
blocks.text: A normal pickup rolls once, but when a full inventory keeps you from picking an item up, it rolls 20 times a second, so the longer you stand there, the likelier you are to lose it. Until the decryption succeeds, keep a few slots free.
Getting it back
When you kill the Lich with a successful decryption, every last confiscated item drops at the Lich's death spot, and chat tells you so. The round is over by then, so picking them up is safe.
They are ordinary dropped items; they despawn if left too long and burn in lava. Pick them up quickly.

entries.title: Requiem Items
items: kuvalich:requiem_gem
kuvalich:requiem_riddle
kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum
kuvalich:lich_reliquary

blocks.text: Decryption and hunts use four items: a gem for crafting blocks, a riddle that shows the answer, an ultimatum that summons a [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]], and the reliquary you only get from a successful hunt.

items: kuvalich:requiem_gem
kuvalich:requiem_riddle
kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum
kuvalich:lich_reliquary

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:requiem_gem}

It drops from {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s you kill yourself, at a base chance of <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemBaseChance|pctv}</t> plus <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemLootingBonus|pctv}</t> per level of <t>Looting</t> on your main-hand weapon.
{item:kuvalich:requiem_riddle}
Right-click it and chat tells you this round's <hl>three cards in the correct order</hl>. Each use consumes 1.

items: You need at least 1 clue revealed first. Used too early, it is not consumed; it only says there is no answer yet and goes on a <t>10</t>-second cooldown.
It has no recipe and never drops; you can only find it in the Creative tab.

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}

Right-click to summon a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}. Each summon uses up 1, except in Creative. Used on air, the Lich appears <t>3</t> blocks in front of you; used on a block, it appears on the face you clicked.
A successful decryption has a <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.requiemUltimatumDropChance|pctv}</t> chance to drop one.
It has no recipe and never drops; you can only find it in the Creative tab.
What you summon is the real boss. Set your cards and gear up first, then use it somewhere open and safe.
{item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary}
Every successful decryption drops exactly 1. The three blocks below all need one to craft, so you cannot build any of them before your first successful hunt.
With the TACZ gun mod installed, it can also permanently enhance guns in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}, see [[tacz/tacz_enhance]].
{item:kuvalich:kuva} and {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} are the other main hunt rewards; see [[start/materials]] for their uses.
